accessibility.reason: fewer than two attributes can reach a 3-point controlled gain

overall.reason: both preregistered representation criteria must pass

robustness.reason: requires ≥20% lower harmless excess NLL and nonzero digit sensitivity at least matching BPE

extraction_budget.policy: conservative wall time; stops between model calls

robustness.alignment: complete edited continuation; exact common prefix and BPE token end

state_definition.bpe: token-end state on the identical causal byte prefix
state_definition.byte: projected completed-patch global path only; local decoder excluded
state_definition.layers: global input, middle block output, final normalized output
